entities.summary: Constantin G. Stere or Constantin Sterea was a Romanian writer, jurist, politician, ideologue of the Poporanist trend, and, in March 1906, co-founder of the literary magazine Viața Românească. One of the central figures of the Bessarabian intelligentsia at the time, Stere was a key actor during the Union of Bessarabia with Romania in 1918, and is associated with its legacy. Constantin Stere was a journalists & chroniclers from Horodiște (1865-06-01, Horodiște–1936-06-26). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
